name: model-economy
description: Generator/arbiter model economy for everyday agent work: reserves the premium session model for judgment and hands bulk reading/exploration and generation to subagents at haiku or opus, keeping the main context small. A PreToolUse hook auto-pins un-pinned Explore spawns to haiku and redirects general-purpose spawns to its own opus-at-medium-effort worker agent; a SessionStart hook injects the economy principle each session.
